crossRefs.note: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute…
But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned…
The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and served the Baals.
They abandoned Yahweh, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of…
It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against Yahweh their God, who brought them up out of the land of…
They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards…
“Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets…

translations.web: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,
translations.bsb: But they tested and disobeyed God Most High, for they did not keep His decrees.
translations.kjv: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
